entities.summary: Kazuma Okamoto  nicknamed “Big Oak” is a Japanese professional baseball infielder for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yomiuri Giants from 2015 until moving to North America in 2026.
